caseName: Ashcroft, Attorney General v. O Centro Espirita Beneficiente Uniao Do Vegetal
caseNameFull: Ashcroft, Attorney General v. O Centro Espirita Beneficente Uniao Do Vegetal Et Al.

opinions.text: C. A. 10th Cir. Application for stay of injunction or, in the alternative, to recall and stay the mandate, presented to Justice Breyer, and by him referred to the Court, denied. The temporary stay entered December 1, 2004, is vacated.
